schema.text: Which of these modes do you use together in the same trip at least once a week? Choose at least two.
schema.help: A combined trip is one where you change mode on the way.

options.text: Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bolt)

en.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bolt)
en.#A combined trip is one where you change: A combined trip is one where you change mode on the way.
en.#Which of these modes do you use togethe: Which of these modes do you use together in the same trip at least once a week? Choose at least two.

it.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi o servizio simile (ad es. Uber, Bolt)
it.#I don't use any combination: Non utilizzo alcuna combinazione di mezzi
it.#A combined trip is one where you change: Uno spostamento combinato è quello in cui cambi mezzo lungo il percorso.
it.#Which of these modes do you use togethe: Quali di questi mezzi usi insieme nello stesso spostamento almeno una volta alla settimana? Scegline almeno due.

fr.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi ou service similaire (par ex. Uber, Bolt)
fr.#I don't use any combination: Je ne combine pas plusieurs modes
fr.#A combined trip is one where you change: Un trajet combiné est un trajet où vous changez de moyen de transport en chemin.
fr.#Which of these modes do you use togethe: Lesquels de ces moyens de transport combinez-vous dans un même trajet au moins une fois par semaine ? Choisissez-en au moins deux.

de.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi oder ähnlicher Fahrdienst (z. B. Uber, Bolt)
de.#A combined trip is one where you change: Ein kombinierter Weg ist einer, bei dem Sie unterwegs das Verkehrsmittel wechseln.
de.#Which of these modes do you use togethe: Welche dieser Verkehrsmittel kombinieren Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche auf demselben Weg? Wählen Sie mindestens zwei aus.

tr.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taksi veya benzeri hizmet (ör. Uber, Bolt)
tr.#I don't use any combination: Herhangi bir ulaşım seçeneği kombinasyonu kullanmıyorum
tr.#A combined trip is one where you change: Birleşik yolculuk, yol üzerinde ulaşım şeklini değiştirdiğiniz yolculuktur.
tr.#Which of these modes do you use togethe: Aşağıdaki ulaşım türlerinden hangilerini haftada en az bir kez aynı yolculukta birlikte kullanıyorsunuz? En az iki tane seçin.

fa.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: تاکسی یا خدمات مشابه (مثلاً Uber، Bolt)
fa.#I don't use any combination: از ترکیب چند روش استفاده نمی‌کنم
fa.#A combined trip is one where you change: سفر ترکیبی سفری است که در آن در طول مسیر وسیلهٔ رفت‌وآمد را عوض می‌کنید.
fa.#Which of these modes do you use togethe: کدام‌یک از این وسایل را دست‌کم هفته‌ای یک بار در یک سفر با هم استفاده می‌کنید؟ دست‌کم دو مورد را انتخاب کنید.

hu.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi vagy hasonló szolgáltatás (pl. Uber, Bolt)
hu.#A combined trip is one where you change: Kombinált út az, amelyen útközben közlekedési módot vált.
hu.#Which of these modes do you use togethe: Az alábbi közlekedési módok közül melyeket használja együtt ugyanazon az úton legalább hetente egyszer? Legalább kettőt válasszon.

ar.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: سيارة أجرة أو خدمة مشابهة (مثل Uber وBolt)
ar.#I don't use any combination: لا أستخدم أكثر من وسيلة في الرحلة نفسها
ar.#Motorcycle, scooter or moped: دراجة نارية أو سكوتر أو دراجة بمحرك صغير
ar.#A combined trip is one where you change: الرحلة المركّبة هي رحلة تغيّر فيها وسيلة النقل أثناء الطريق.
ar.#Walking (stretches of at least 10 minut: سيرًا على الأقدام (مسافات لا تقل عن 10 دقائق)
ar.#Which of these modes do you use togethe: أي من وسائل النقل هذه تستخدمها معًا في التنقل نفسه مرة واحدة على الأقل في الأسبوع؟ اختر وسيلتين على الأقل.
